title: Road Hazard Protection — Out-of-Area Tire Replacement Reimbursement
content:
## Scope
This governs a covered tire replacement the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate bought from a shop outside the Crestline network, with the damage more than the plan's out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store, when the damaged tire was not surrendered to a Crestline store (a photo of it was submitted instead) and the receipt covers the out-of-area reimbursement. Only such a replacement is reimbursed at the out-of-area reimbursement here. Every other out-of-area replacement — one whose damaged tire was surrendered, or whose receipt falls short of the out-of-area reimbursement — is reimbursed on the base replacement reimbursement terms; for every out-of-area replacement, a plan whose out-of-area replacement cap is 0.00 does not reimburse out-of-area replacements. Commercial use is judged on the service date.

**Receipt covers.** The receipt covers the out-of-area reimbursement when the amount the holder paid the outside shop on it is at least the out-of-area reimbursement.

**Out of area.** For such a replacement the damage counts as out of area when the place of the damage, as the holder reads it from the outside shop's receipt, lies more than the plan's out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store. An out-of-area tire repair reimbursed at the out-of-area repair reimbursement and an out-of-area tow reimbursed at the out-of-area tow reimbursement state their own out-of-area condition; every other out-of-area claim keeps the base out-of-area condition, that the damage occurred more than the out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store.

**Effect.** The reimbursement is paid to the tender the certificate was bought with and is booked as an out-of-area replacement reimbursement entry under a new claim number. It then counts toward the certificate's claims, the wheel position's replacements and the benefits paid.

## Invocation: `reimburse_hazard_outside_replacement_5f5d3272`
**Capability.** Books the reimbursement of a covered tire replacement the holder bought from a shop outside the Crestline network while far from any Crestline store. One call opens a new claim number and books one out-of-area replacement reimbursement entry with the receipt date, wheel position, damage on the receipt, tread on the receipt, coverage percentage, amount reimbursed and the tender it is paid to.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**
- `hazard_certificate_id` — reference number of the certificate the reimbursement is paid under, as returned by the certificate lookup for this holder.
- `tire_position` — wheel position of the replaced tire: one of `LF` (left front wheel), `RF` (right front wheel), `LR` (left rear wheel), `RR` (right rear wheel), `SP` (the matching full-size spare) or `none` (no wheel position applies to the entry).
- `damage_type` — damage shown on the receipt: one of `puncture_tread` (a puncture in the tread area), `puncture_shoulder` (a puncture in the shoulder), `sidewall_cut` (a cut or gash in the sidewall), `impact_break` (a break or bulge from an impact), `bead_damage` (damage at the bead) or `none` (no damage applies to the entry).
- `service_date` — date printed on the outside shop's receipt, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `remaining_tread_32nds` — tread depth shown on the receipt for the damaged tire, integer, 32nds of an inch.
- `coverage_pct` — share applied to the replacement, integer percent from 0 to 100.
- `amount` — amount reimbursed to the holder, USD to 2 decimal places.
- `payment_method` — tender the reimbursement is paid to: one of `none` (no tender applies), `cash_or_debit` (certificate paid in cash or by debit card), `bank_card` (paid with a bank-issued credit card), `crestline_card` (paid with a Crestline credit card) or `fleet_account` (charged to a Crestline fleet account).

**Return.** A line beginning "Reimbursed" gives the reimbursement entry reference, the new claim number (RHC- followed by 7 digits), the wheel position, the coverage percentage, the amount in USD to 2 decimal places and the tender; it means the reimbursement is on the certificate.
